input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position in full. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000 (§21.1); the "Fees" definition (§1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, and with the USD 2,000,000 annual commitment in §2.1 the fees-based limb is a meaningful figure, not illusory. §21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages with a helpful carve-back confirming data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages. §21.3 places all preferred carve-outs outside the cap (confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP) with no super-cap, and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages". §21.4 preserves liability that cannot lawfully be limited and severability of each cap. No competing or hidden cap language appears elsewhere in the document. No redline required.
